proposal.description: MISO is also cut by the unfiltered synchronised CS_n, so read data drops at once on a deselect (or a CS glitch) instead of following spi_slave's S_READ phase on the filtered chip select
proposal.reason: During a read, MISO goes low about SPI_FILTER_CLKS clocks before sdio_oe falls after CS_n rises. A CS_n glitch shorter than the filter, which spi_slave ignores, now forces MISO low in the middle of a read data bit.

proposal.description: reg_file's STATUS power-good bit is fed fault_LED's registered pgood_LED copy instead of PGOOD itself, so telemetry lags the changeover by a clock
proposal.reason: A STATUS read whose snapshot falls on the clock where PGOOD changes (PGOOD qualifies, or drops on a rail dip or on leaving S_RUN) returns the old PGOOD value. That disagrees with the PGOOD and switch_supply pins.

proposal.description: reg_file's SCR latch status bit ORs in the CPLD's own trip drive latch_out, as if 'latch set' meant 'either source driving it', instead of reporting the debounced physical read-back alone
proposal.reason: After a strike latch, the latch status bit reads 1 as soon as latch_out asserts, before the SCR read-back has debounced. It stays 1 even if the SCR never fires, so STATUS no longer shows only the read-back the supervisor acts on.

proposal.description: pgood_gen's 'regulating' qualifier is also ANDed with the gate-driver enable, as if PGOOD had to drop with the combinational fault gating of En rather than when the supervisor leaves S_RUN
proposal.reason: When OTP, UVLO or a latch trip asserts in S_RUN, PGOOD and switch_supply now fall on the same clock as En instead of one clock later, when run_active falls. The qualify counter is also cleared one clock earlier.

proposal.description: strike_counter is handed the clean-run target minus one, taking the counter to count from zero to target-1, although it clears strikes when clean_counter equals the target itself
proposal.reason: After a hiccup and a retry into S_RUN, strike_level (and the Red_LED1 strike blink) clears after clean_run_target-1 fault-free switching cycles instead of clean_run_target. The strike level is visible over SPI and on Red_LED1.
